question: Parts of a tower crane and their functions?
text:
A typical **horizontal-jib tower crane** moves a load in three ways: the **hoist** raises and lowers it, the **trolley** moves it closer to or farther from the tower, and the **slewing unit** swings it around the tower. ([highworks.co.kr](https://www.highworks.co.kr/_lib/daumeditor/down.html?fname=20150119101030650979.pdf&orifname=312TL%2812TON+Topless+crane%29%EC%A0%9C%EC%9B%90%ED%91%9C.pdf&utm_source=openai))

| Part | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Base and foundation** | Support the crane and transfer its forces into the ground. On a fixed-base crane, anchors secure the base to the foundation. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101)) |
| **Mast (tower)** | The vertical steel structure that gives the crane its height and supports the upper assembly. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101)) |
| **Slewing unit (turntable)** | Uses a large bearing and drive system to rotate the upper assembly around the mast. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101)) |
| **Jib (working arm)** | The long arm that provides reach and supports the trolley. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101)) |
| **Trolley** | Travels along the horizontal jib to position the hook closer to or farther from the mast. ([highworks.co.kr](https://www.highworks.co.kr/_lib/daumeditor/down.html?fname=20150119101030650979.pdf&orifname=312TL%2812TON+Topless+crane%29%EC%A0%9C%EC%9B%90%ED%91%9C.pdf&utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hoist winch and rope** | The winch winds or pays out the rope to raise or lower the hook and load. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101)) |
| **Hook block** | The hook-and-pulley assembly suspended from the hoist rope. The hook connects to the load’s lifting gear. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101)) |
| **Counter-jib and counterweights** | The shorter rear arm carries counterweights that help offset the overturning effect of the working jib and its load. It may also carry machinery. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101)) |
| **Operator’s cab and controls** | Let the operator control lifting, trolley travel, and rotation. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101)) |
| **Climbing frame and tie-ins, where fitted** | The climbing system lets the crane gain height as construction progresses; tie-ins brace the mast against the building. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101)) |

A **luffing-jib crane** changes its reach by raising or lowering the angle of the jib rather than by moving a trolley along a fixed horizontal arm. ([liebherr.com](https://www.liebherr.com/en-us/p/82086-8471547?utm_source=openai))
